title: Verify Noodle as an independent feature app through real owner entries
body:
## Intent and one consumer atom
The user explicitly selected an independent `verify-noodle` skill and Noodle feature map in Soodles, referenced by the existing `execute` skill. Do not create a second execute, scheduler, worktree manager or recovery owner. Noodle remains the app being driven; Soodles owns this verification consumer.

## Precondition and boundary
Consume the independently accepted Noodle owner correction from ed3c/noodle#84 under a fresh measured binary/carrier selection. Preserve the existing Soodles production checkpoint until its owner safely reconciles it. Register this Issue as a real Noodle order before its implementation writer starts; no empty post-hoc order. Soodles #44 and #39 retain their own delivery and evidence boundaries.

Allowed correction: `.agents/skills/verify-noodle/` (SKILL.md, feature index/recipes, bounded driver helpers), a narrow invocation in existing `.agents/skills/execute/SKILL.md`, and demonstrated routing/contract pointers plus scoped evidence. Correct erroneous recipes/helpers and nearest discriminating controls together in this atom. Product defects belong to the actual transition owner and must not be hidden by the map.

## pstack create and maintenance
Use fixed `ed3c/plugins@68836ddaf5697224520f1847d90cdb90ca8babaa` create-verification-skill and maintain-verification-skill instructions, adapted to this repository's `.agents/skills` location. Interview actual CLI/help/source and existing harnesses. Map only demonstrated Noodle features with user entry, drive, observable end state and limitations. Cover exact CLI identity/skill resolution, initial proposal retirement/recovery, and genuine order/session handoff as supported; keep full provider delivery distinct.

Create must actually launch/doctor/drive a mapped feature, capture raw argv/output/exit/subject evidence, clean owned residue and verify evidence survives. Then maintain the independent map: source review for each feature, coordinator live drive for every mapped feature, and honest clean/changed/blocked result. No unchecked placeholder recipes or invented commands. A feature requiring a real admitted subject remains blocked until one exists; do not invent a production order merely for coverage.

## N / P / L / R and completion
N: feature inventory and reports. P: skill guidance consuming owner `next` and naming missing inputs/provider/continuation. L: existing subject-bound executable owner checks and any necessary bounded helper controls. R: exact provider checks, merge and closure truth. For each newly added executable gate, retain defect RED, corrected same-control GREEN and legal non-case GREEN; correct refusal is GREEN. Selection of the external verifier must precede final candidate acceptance.

Complete canonical Soodles acceptance for the final clean candidate, exact-head provider checks, supervised merge/Issue closure readback, original Noodle order completion and local cleanup. Creation or green tests alone do not resolve the atom. Publish no claim of reduced Agent decision cost without a corresponding comparison. This Issue currently records authorized scope only; implementation and complete maintenance are pending.

## Admission contract and implementation scope
The first map is deliberately limited to three demonstrated Noodle CLI features. This correction changes guidance and routing only; existing independently accepted owners remain the executable discriminators. The authenticated entry from Soodles #44 must be delivered before this atom's writer starts. Full create/maintenance and delivery remain pending.
